lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: Flip the switch and electrons zoom down the wire at light speed.

lines.speaker: gus
lines.text: They must. The light comes on instantly.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: Here's how fast they really go.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: A wire is packed with so many electrons that each one only has to creep.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: The light is instant because the push travels fast. Every electron starts moving at once.

lines.speaker: vera
lines.text: The signal is fast. The electrons are slow.
